bugs_found: transfer returns a Receipt with amount divided by 2, silently corrupting audit/receipt data
transfer mutates source before destination update, so a failure during destination balance addition can leave accounts inconsistent
transfer does not normalize/validate amount as Decimal, allowing float/type edge cases and arithmetic TypeError after validation
compound_interest silently truncates fractional years and compounds_per_year via int(), changing requested terms without error
loan_payment silently truncates fractional months via int(), changing repayment schedule without error
money-returning functions do not quantize/round to currency precision, risking unexpected fractional-cent balances
